# Offline integration boundary and next decisions

> Focus on what the synthesis lists as still open and on hardening.

Matches order: yes. This package is an offline extension of the earlier foundation. Original sources and production callers are read-only. Importing this package cannot repair an unchanged upstream entry point.

| Seam | Implemented here | Production action still needed |
|---|---|---|
| D09 | Closed, signed fixture receipt; authority/slot/time/lineage/media joins; atomic replay-safe commit | Director selects playback completion surface, interrupted-playback semantics, signer and verifier trust. Replace boolean aired readers. |
| D13/D14, B04 | Placement/review versions, durable backlog, explicit release and aired-only consumption | Replace consumed-at-assembly and arbitrary setters; preserve permanent contributor/message IDs. |
| D15/D10, D16/D17 | Versioned proposals, accepted state stills, aired primary changes and explicit tier clocks | Select current authoritative bible, trusted still review and production canon storage. |
| B01 | Approval is not settled head; scoped preemption; receipt settles canon | Replace slot callers; reconcile canonical ownership and migration before enabling writes. |
| D08 | Local export registers bytes only; episodes_done derives aired completed episodes | Replace unaired-export episode counters. |
| A07 | Durable intake before seen/wrap; closed fixture replay and retry recovery | Implement and authenticate actual live capture. Replay-only tooling is not live steering. |
| D12 | Gates at queue, render and air; failures persist without consuming prompts | Connect real moderation, canon review and media/audio QC; fail closed on unavailable review. |
| B15 | Backlog works without a scheduler | Future scheduler must use the same authority; no live scheduling is implemented. |
| Render/inventory | Exact manifests, route/ref/prompt/review binding, revisioned channel records, blocked estimates | Establish complete logical inventory, trusted direct approval intake and shared spend/reservation semantics. No provider is included here. |

`reports/adapter-audit.json` provides exact read-only source paths, hashes, definition locations and replacement descriptions. `Adapters(life).call(machine, action, **payload)` remains the gateway. The audit rejects known direct legacy imports/setters, aliases and simple reflected calls. It does not make arbitrary external Python safe. Existing non-transition helpers are extracted through the prior allowlist, with source/AST provenance; unrelated production logic was not rewritten.

The public fixture HMAC key is intentionally not a production credential. `authority_id` prevents a correctly signed receipt from another independent fixture database being accepted, but anyone controlling the fixture signer, verifier or database can fabricate a simulation. Synthetic yes records require `mode=offline-fixture`; no value in this store authorizes money or actual air. Do not import these rows into a live receipt, approval, spend or canon ledger. Existing prototype databases lack the new authority/contract fields and are refused rather than silently migrated. All demonstrations start in a new output directory.

Real-time media conclusions remain blocked: file hashes prove byte identity, not that a still depicts damage, that a comment appears on screen, that moderation is adequate, or that motion/audio/rights checks passed. The fixture replay adapter proves durability only. OUTWARD HOLD remains a boundary, not a defect to bypass.

The synthesis corrections govern metadata. Most fields are scaffolding. The short continuous-thread list is hero arc, core want/identity, show goal, planted hints and Saga. Metadata records label their role but never become executable rules. General aliases use immutable IDs and audit reasons; episode/bridge options belong only to explicit character crossover tests. Candidate Nest/Depth/Portal/Pivot/Drifter/Prophecy mechanisms are not promoted into new creative rules. Declared portal/pivot moves must come from prompts; still/edit recommendations are refused. Zipper remains a seam/loop repair candidate only, and no edit is executed.

Further production work requires a separate authorized write scope. Human or Director decisions: receipt/approval/review authorities; storage and migration owner; current authoritative Ch4 bible and permitted candidate mechanisms; live capture source and identity semantics; complete inventory and spend reconciliation; rollout order and CI gates. Any actual render, spend, publish or air still requires trundle's applicable direct approval. No new decision is needed to inspect or rerun this offline package.
